verdict.rationale: Morph publishes an official MCP server (guides/mcp.md, quickstart 'Install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can read it') that lets external agents like Claude Code connect to its fast file-editing/search tools, confirmed live via probe [morph-probe-4]. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server works as documented (community evidence only covers the apply model, not MCP connectivity), and no detail on MCP tool list/config beyond the guide.
